rows.en: Hold on! Seravee's still inside the Terminal Unit!
Wait! Seravee isn't back yet.
Hey, Seravee's still holed up in that Terminal-whatsit. Let's wait up for him, yeah?
Wait! Seravee isn't back yet, y'know!?
Please wait! Seravee isn't back yet.
Wait! Seravee isn't back yet.
Wait! Seravee isn't back yet.
Wait! Seravee isn't back yet.
Wait! Seravee isn't back yet.
Wait! Seravee isn't back yet.
Wait! Seravee isn't back yet.
...Whoops, that's right.
But we're out of time.
So this is the Terminal Unit.
...Sorry to keep you waiting.
Hey, Seravee! So how'd it go with Veda?
Cherudim. So you'd already regrouped with the others.
I've pinpointed Veda's location.
Oh! Nice work!!
But... we've got some bad news for you.
...Would that happen to be about the giant weapons?
...What, you already knew...?
Yes. It was in Veda's data.
What's more, the latest data says the energy charge on each giant weapon is building up.
Figured as much... Guess we've got no choice but to hunt them down one by one...
No... Splitting into squads would be more efficient. Let's work out a tactical plan right away.
The heroes moved to the control room.
With Seravee at the center, they quickly hammered out squad assignments and a battle plan.
I've confirmed three giant weapons: Memento Mori, the Barge Cannon and the Libra Cannon.
Each has its own separate control room, but all of them are located on the middle levels.
We'll seize those control rooms and shut the weapons down.
Hold on, Seravee. What about the Colony Laser? Any information?
Seravee, isn't there any information on the Colony Laser?
Seravee, isn't there any information on the Colony Laser?
It definitely exists, but unfortunately, I couldn't pinpoint its location.
I see... Let's just be glad we could at least locate the other giant weapons.
Is that so... Well, let's be glad we could at least locate the other giant weapons.
Can't be helped... Let's be glad we could at least locate the other giant weapons.
But seizing the control rooms alone worries me, so we'll also cut their power at the source.
We're going after the power source?
Yes. In fact, I detected a spot on the lower levels giving off an extremely high energy reading.
My guess is that's where the power source feeding energy to the giant weapons is.
So if we destroy that, none of them will be able to fire, right?
Exactly.
And lastly, Veda's main body. I've traced it to the deepest part of this Cube.
The deepest part, huh... Sounds like a long way.
So I plan to split us into three squads and launch a simultaneous assault.
First, Sandrock, Deathscythe, Heavyarms and Birth. You four will
seize the control room of each giant weapon and stop it from firing, or else destroy the cannon itself.
For convenience, we'll call these four the "Gundam Team."
Understood.
Next, {8074} and the rest of the Hero Team. I need you to destroy the power source.
The spot with the high energy reading, right?
The spot with the high energy reading, right?
The spot with the high energy reading, right?
The spot with the high energy reading, right?
The spot with the high energy reading, right?
The spot with the high energy reading, right?
You mean the spot with the high energy reading?
You mean the spot with the high energy reading?
The spot with the high energy reading, yes?
The spot with the high energy reading, right?
The spot with the high energy reading, right?
The spot with the high energy reading, right?
The spot with the high energy reading, right?
The spot with the high energy reading, right?
The spot with the high energy reading, right?
Yes. First, head down to the lower levels. I've marked the stairs on your MAP.
Once you're on the lower levels, the high-energy spot should show up on your MAP automatically.
Mission accepted.
All right, got it!
Understood.
Roger!
Understood.
Yeah! You got it!
Understood!
Understood!
You can leave it to us.
Understood.

notes.note: Leader-variant block 0.199-0.213 (begins in story_118) follows the Pt_Chara_Check chain right before it: 10,9,6,7,4,5,3,15,14,8,13,12,11,2,1 = 00, Wing Zero, Nu, Zeta, W, OOO, Den-O, Zero, Mebius, God, Taro, Seven, Ultraman, RX, Rider 1. This row = W; 0.204 = OOO (its Japanese is the same blunt line as most rows, so same English).
Den-O (Momotaros): he can't remember the name ('Terminal nantoka') -> 'Terminal-whatsit'. 'matte yarou ze' = let's wait for him (Seravee, g=m).
Mebius (polite, '-san' on Seravee); honorific dropped, politeness via 'Please'.

Uncertain speaker. The script names Deathscythe for n=214 and Ankh for n=215; with the usual id = n+1 mapping this row is never shown and Deathscythe says 0.215 (n=215 would point past the table). If the mapping is off by one here, 0.214 = Deathscythe and 0.215 = Ankh. Wording kept neutral so either reading works.
Labelled Deathscythe Hell; could be Ankh (see 0.214). 'jikan ga nee' = there's no time; subject 'we' restored.

Speakers for 0631 recovered from the event script (unlabelled in the slice): 0.1/4/7/8/10/13/36 Cherudim; 0.3/5/6/9/11/12/14/19-21/25/29/31/32/34/35/37-40/42/58/59 Seravee; 0.30/33 Arios; 0.41 Sandrock; 0.2 no name tag (silence, likely Seravee emerging); 0.16/17 narration.
'gouryuu shite ita no ka' = so you had joined up (with the heroes) -> 'regrouped with the others'.
'enerugii chaaji ga susunde iru' = the charging is progressing -> 'building up'. 'kyodai heiki' = 'giant weapons' throughout (not in glossary).
'shiramitsubushi' = exhaustively, one at a time -> 'hunt them down one by one'.

Memento Mori (00), Barge Cannon (Wing, OZ's Barge), Libra Cannon (Wing, Libra's main cannon): standard English names, not in glossary. 'three' added to introduce the list; the Japanese lists exactly three.
Variants 0.22-0.24 are guarded by Pt_Chara_Check(6)/(7): 0.22 = Nu Gundam, 0.23 = Zeta Gundam, 0.24 = any other leader. Same for 0.26-0.28 (wakatta / sou ka / shikata ga nai).
'fuan da' = it's not reassuring -> 'worries me'; 'doujini' (simultaneously) folded into 'also' to fit the box.
Sentence split across 0.38/0.39 at the same point as the Japanese. The source itself shortens Deathscythe Hell to 'Deathscythe' here; kept.
Japanese corner brackets -> double quotes. Birth is counted in the 'Gundam Team' as in the source.
{8074} = party leader name variable. 'tanomu' = Seravee asking the Hero Team -> 'I need you to destroy...'.

Variant blocks 0.43-0.57 and 0.60-0.74 follow the chain at the top of the script: 9,8,10,7,6,15,14,5,4,13,3,12,11,1,2 = Wing Zero, God, 00, Zeta, Nu, Zero, Mebius, OOO, W, Taro, Den-O, Seven, Ultraman, Rider 1, RX. Wording matches (0.49/0.50 polite = Mebius/OOO, 0.51 'da ne' = W, 0.60 'Mission accepted' = Wing Zero, 0.65 Zero, 0.68 Philip's 'boku-tachi', 0.70 Momotaros).
MAP kept in caps as in earlier slices; 'kaidan no ichi' = the stairs' location -> 'marked the stairs'.

report: 80/80 rows. Leader-variant blocks mapped from the Pt_Chara_Check chains in 0629/0631; 0631 speakers recovered from the event script. Uncertain: 0629#0.214/0.215 speaker (Deathscythe vs Ankh; script indices run one past the table). Not in glossary: Memento Mori, Barge Cannon, Libra Cannon, Terminal Unit, Veda, Gundam Team, 'giant weapons'.
